finding: The proposal offers no fixed target or independently semantic incompatible slot. Even with a valid slot, failure to separate from opaque controls cannot refute a role.
countermodels: The whole and all matched opaque controls can share the true role R and validly avoid the same incompatible slot. Their rates are identical although R is true. Opaque does not mean semantically negative.

An analyst labels an observed structural slot process-only using inherited German renderings. An item can legitimately appear there under a different grammar or ellipsis; its occupancy falsifies the combined slot/grammar/role assumptions, not the lexical role alone.
correction_to_agent: The raw review says validated occupancy falsifies R; this is conditional on independently warranted incompatibility, role scope and construction/measurement assumptions. Its entire semantic bundle must be named. Failure to beat controls is never in itself a counterexample to R.
minimum_repair: Fix whole W, claimed scope R, incompatible semantic slot S, construction and error assumptions; separate tests of the conjunction, power/capacity and mere control discrimination. Independently justify S before outcome access.
